reason: I'd take the free visit to look, but $14 a visit adds up fast on our budget when the library and the park are free. I'm not paying for a membership on a place I haven't seen.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? A Baby Nook for under-2s sounds nice, but 25 kids up to age 5 in one room is still a lot, and I'd be paying $14 a visit to find out.
would_change_my_mind: A free visit that shows the Baby Nook really keeps the bigger kids out and the room stays calm, plus a cheaper weekday-morning drop-in around $8 to $10 that fits around our shifts.
